title: Bakugan Gen 3 Wave 2 Red Titanium Special Attack Nillious - New
descriptionText:
This Bakugan Generation 3 Wave 2 action figure is a must-have for collectors and fans of the franchise. The figure features Nillious, a character from the TV show, in a special attack pose with a red titanium design. It is made of durable plastic and comes boxed with transforming capabilities.

The figure is manufactured in 2023 by Spin Master and is part of the Bakugan franchise. It is categorized under Toys & Hobbies, Action Figures & Accessories, and Action Figures. Get ready to add this rare and highly sought-after figure to your collection.
